description: Two Thomas strange attractors, each giving a pair of related voltages that wander without repeating; slow enough they are modulation, fast enough they are a noisy tone.

params.text: The rate the second attractor is stepped at.
The rate the first attractor is stepped at.
How much the first SPEED jack moves the first attractor's rate. With nothing patched there this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the second SPEED jack moves the second attractor's rate. With nothing patched there this knob is a fine tune instead.
The damping constant of the first attractor, which sets how tightly it spirals.
The damping constant of the second attractor, which sets how tightly it spirals.
Output level of the first attractor.
Output level of the second attractor.
Sets the rate range both attractors cover: up is the audio range, middle is a clock range, down is a slow modulation range.

inputs.text: Moves the first attractor's rate, by as much as the MOD knob beside the first SPEED allows.
Moves the second attractor's rate, by as much as the MOD knob beside the second SPEED allows.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the MOD knob acts as a fine tune.
